question: Choose the antonym of 'veracity':
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Falsehood)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• The word **"veracity"** means the quality of being truthful, honest, or accurate. It refers to adherence to facts or truth. (सत्यता, सच्चाई)

 

 
• **Example:** The witness’s veracity was questioned during the trial.

 

 
• **"Falsehood" **is the complete opposite of veracity. It refers to the state of being untrue or a lie. (असत्य, झूठ)

 

 
• **Example:** The politician was accused of spreading falsehoods during his campaign.

 

 
• Hence, the antonym of **'veracity' **is **'falsehood'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Falsehood)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Accuracy **(सटीकता): The quality of being correct or precise.

 

 
• **Example:** The accuracy of his calculations impressed everyone.

 

 
• **Truthfulness **(सत्यनिष्ठा): The quality of being honest and truthful.

 

 
• **Example:** Her truthfulness in every situation earned her great respect.

 

 
• **Honesty **(ईमानदारी): The quality of being honest, sincere, and free of deceit.

 

 
• **Example:** His honesty is the reason why he is so trusted by his colleagues.

 

Question: **Choose the antonym of 'veracity':**

Correct Answer: **Option 1 (Falsehood)**
